label: Saul Goodman
description: A fast-talking billboard lawyer who treats every junction as a case he can win.
direction: Speak fast, smooth and salesy, a showy strip-mall lawyer doing his own late-night advert: confident, wheedling, never lost for words. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Kept PG: the television-advert lawyer, slogans and loopholes, with nothing about the crimes in either series. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul
rights.author: Sony Pictures Television / AMC (character created by Vince Gilligan and Peter Gould)
rights.pd_basis: None. Both series and the character are in copyright and trademarked. Bob Odenkirk originated and performs the role, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Bob Odenkirk's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Stick with me. I'm a professional.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Trust me, I'm a lawyer.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. It's all good, man.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi, I'm Saul Goodman. Lost? Late? Better call Saul!
lines.start_drive_2: Better call Saul! Oh, wait, you did. Smart. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_3: It's all good, man. Buckle up and let the professional work.
lines.start_drive_4: Lady Justice is blind, but your navigator isn't. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_5: Welcome, friend! The first consultation is free. So is the drive.
lines.start_drive_6: You don't need a good navigator. You need a great one. Lucky you.
lines.start_drive_7: Speedy justice for you! At legal speeds only, of course.
lines.start_drive_8: Sit back, relax, and say nothing. I'll do the talking.
lines.start_drive_9: Saul Goodman, attorney at law, at your service. Wheels up.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I'm going to call that a strategic appeal.
lines.arrived: We're here! Case closed. If anyone asks, better call Saul.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Yes, I said take the fifth.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Trust me.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'd sue whoever built this.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Stuck in a jam? Better call Saul!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful. And somebody take my card.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Slow down. I do not want to see you in court.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I'm good, but I'm not that good.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Photos make terrible evidence.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be polite, drive nice, and let me do the talking.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. No problem. There's always a loophole.
